messages:
lee: heads-up — ap-southeast1 cohort is causing GPU attach backs. lots of pending attaches, attaching jobs getting stuck. noticed long nvme IOPS tails on the fresh cohort today.
sam: confirmation: attach latencies ballooning, some retries. any kernel logs?
maria: found repeated `I/O error, dev nvme0n1` on 3 hosts. grabbing dmesg snippets now.
lee: pasted dmesg excerpt:
```
[ 2345.678901] nvme nvme0: I/O 0xdef456 timed out
[ 2345.679012] blk_update_request: I/O error, dev nvme0n1, sector 987654
[ 2346.780123] nvme_core: Admin command timeout
```
kyle: `iostat -x 1 5` shows nvme %util pegged near 100% on the problematic drives, but queue depth isn't huge. smells like firmware scrub/GC running.
sam: is this the fw we rolled last week (v7.1.2)? we updated the ap-southeast cohort Tue night.
maria: yes — small cohort with refreshed drives and new fw.
lee: timeline matches scrub windows starting 00:30 local and a large batch provisioning spike at 00:35. likely write amplification + scrub concurrency.
oncall: ops-bot alert: "GPU_PROVISIONING_HOLD ap-southeast1: 38 pending" at 1725554280
kyle: mitigation options: 1) throttle janitor/scrub on affected hosts; 2) exclude the cohort from autoscaler so new GPU jobs land elsewhere; 3) cordon/drain hosts with errors.
maria: I'm prepping a hotpatch to set `scrub.enabled=false` for the cohort label. I'll also taint the 12 impacted nodes: `nvme-longtail:NoSchedule` and drain pending pods.
sam: be mindful — shifting workloads to us-west will incur cross-region egress and preemptible cost. ops wants a quick cost estimate before broad spill.
lee: short-term SLA risk > egress cost. recommend minimal spill: move only failing attach jobs for the 12 nodes.
kyle: hotpatch applied to maintenance job; `scrub.enabled=false` rolled out to 12 nodes.
maria: disabled scrub, cordoning nodes, draining pending attaches now. one sec for success rates.
lee: attach success rate climbed to ~78% after drains. a few hosts still show intermittent read errors — marking them for replacement and scheduling drive swaps.
oncall: created incident INC-2026-1347, adding storage and hardware teams. planning drive replacements for 3 nodes.
sam: follow-ups: 1) add telemetry to catch firmware scrub and gpu-provisioner active overlap; 2) auto-deprioritize scrub under heavy attach; 3) run a firmware cohort health sweep before next rollout.
maria: will add a Grafana panel combining NVMe %util, kernel I/O errors, and GPU-provisioner pending counts. also adding an alert for nvme admin timeouts.
kyle: we should also expose `nvme-core` admin timeout counts as a disk health SLI.
lee: short-term plan: replace 3 drives, keep remaining 9 in monitored mode until scrub re-enable. re-enable scrub in 2 hours with reduced concurrency.
maria: ack — will re-enable scrub with slower concurrency window and monitor. :thumbsup:
sam: adding a brief postmortem note to the storage runbook and linking incident.
ops-bot: started deploy gpu-autoscaler-v2 with `--exclude-pool=apse1-new-nvme` at 1725554880
lee: final: cost tradeoff accepted for SLA. schedule a sync tomorrow for firmware rollout cadence and staggered scrub windows. :coffee:
